decisions.exactScope: ICE offers that independently pass the offer-level exact gate; electrified offers remain blocked until required certified/utilization/30-minute power is source-bound

evidence.access: repeated public detail fetches are stable at the extracted contract level
evidence.identity: direct Home/Cars?id=<sourceOfferId> URLs, stable VIN and repeated offer contract
evidence.priceCurrency: detail price matches public homepage/list price; public CarsList explicitly labels the price dimension as 价格(US $)
evidence.body: offer-bound 车型 field, including 轿车 and SUV across audited samples
evidence.engine: offer-bound 排量 (ml); for ICE, mL is an exact volumetric unit equivalent to cm3/cc
evidence.power: offer-bound 功率 (kw); adapter must preserve raw kW and perform only documented deterministic unit conversion to project powerHp
evidence.gallery: 10-20 images are isolated inside the offer core before recommendation cards on audited ICE offers
evidence.listDetailParity: homepage name+numeric price matches detail on audited offers; public list currency contract is USD

blockersBeforePublication: write and test a dedicated Good Car adapter
document and regression-test deterministic kW -> project powerHp conversion while retaining raw kW provenance
full no-write offer-level exact dry-run across diverse ICE offers
manual spot-check of normalized cards and listing-bound images
China remains non-published at the current project stage

decisions.useScope: public lead/search only; no automatic full calculation
decisions.evidence: Public detail exposes identity/year/price/body and 2.0L, but source-bound fuel/power and listing gallery were not proven; the discovered same-offer configuration route redirects to login.

decisions.useScope: auction-history/reference support only; never a standalone public catalog card under the current route
decisions.evidence: The audited public sample is a Statistics page for Hitachi EX55UR-3 heavy machinery, exposes incomplete offer fields and <=2 image identities, and fails the standalone exact-card contract.
The known vehicle-like public URL repeatedly returns a generic Auto Auctions shell with no bound vehicle fields or listing gallery; no usable exact or lead identity is proven on this route.

safety: Class assignment is a research ledger decision only. No source receives publishAllowed=true and no production catalog, generation, manifest, cleanup or Object Storage write occurs.
